scope: Actual owned loopback app data and browser gestures; synthetic seeded works. No cloud/provider action.
checks: Cards includes the authorized saved-card/answer inventory with a working explicit Refresh action.
The app hover drag handle moves its one whole canvas object.
Library Add creates one App Card, with no app subcard expander/remove or resize.
The /focus command preserves Stack mode, selected part and the whole-app frame.
Open → Stack → Open reuses one frame and original component nodes/position; no blank legacy stack.
Focus from App Card opens the whole app sequence and returns to the same App Card.
Open page opens the authorized member app in a separate tab.
Real query cards settle and redundant successful Ready badges are absent.
Only Open resizes; switching away and back retains the last Open dimensions.
Personal Apps/Cards categorization is reversible and preserves one atomic multi-part work.
Reload restores one Open frame, without loose components.
Whole-app removal persists through reload and leaves the Library entry.
